integrity: All quantitative statements are analytic consequences of the stated window-and-pulse model. Exact rational diagnostics check sample cases without serving as proof. Publication priority requires external independent evaluation.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time idealization of the degree-heating-weeks rolling sum for two equal rectangular heatwaves, not the actual daily sampled NOAA algorithm or a bleaching probability model. The jump depends on exact equality plateaus and may not survive pulse smoothing or noise.
title: Exact threshold-duration jumps for two marine heatwaves under rolling thermal accumulation
